label: Established the primacy of the lived body in Phenomenology of Perception
description: Maurice Merleau-Ponty formulated and introduced the concept of "The Primacy of Embodied Perception (Le Corps Propre)", which became a seminal contribution in mind philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in mind.
historicalContext: Introduced during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis as part of Maurice Merleau-Ponty's canonical writings.

citations.author: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
citations.work: The Primacy of Embodied Perception (Le Corps Propre)

label: Influenced French post-war focus on the disciplined historical body
description: Michel Foucault was fundamentally influenced by Maurice Merleau-Ponty's central inquiries, which shaped the evolution of their philosophical worldview.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Maurice Merleau-Ponty's perspective to Michel Foucault's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Inter-epochal reception: transmitting insights from the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis across history into the Contemporary & Post-Structural.
